mentions.name: Levithas
mentions.description: A skill-learning app ('stop consuming, start skilling') that counters doom-scrolling and passive content consumption by getting people to actively learn skills that build curiosity and confidence; positioned as a movement and lifestyle to 'get our life back'.
mentions.problem: Doom-scrolling and passive consumption of content instead of learning skills
mentions.audience: People prone to doom-scrolling and passive content consumption who want to learn skills
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on Levithas (https://levithas.app): stop consuming, start skilling.

I want to go against doom-scrolling and passive consumption of content.
